line: The {missions} in-game daily missions with every known level, the activity bar rewards and the routine tasks.

totals.title: Activeness totals
totals.explanation: A mission adds the Activeness of every level done, up to the level reached. Level 1 of all {missions} missions is {levelOne} Activeness. Every known level of all {missions} missions is {allLevels}.

missions.title: In-game missions
missions.levelCount: {count, plural, one {{amount} known level} other {{amount} known levels}}

missing.title: Not in the data yet
missing.levels: Other mission levels. Every mission has {min} to {max} known levels. Higher levels are not in the package yet, so the totals can grow.
missing.reset: Daily reset time. The package has none. The tracker uses its own default of {time} UTC and labels it as the app default.
